name: Ashbell Village
description: Rain beads on the well-rope. Beyond the last thatched roof, the pines stand close as listeners. The chapel bell has been silent for three winters; tonight, someone has laid fresh flowers beneath its door.

east.blocked_text: The elder keeps the chapel gate locked. Speak with her first.

name: The Pine Track
description: The path narrows to a seam of black earth. A shepherd's red thread hangs from a thorn, turning slowly though there is no wind. Something pale moves between the roots.

name: The Roofless Chapel
description: Birch saplings rise between the pews. Above them the bell hangs whole, its clapper bound in red thread. Scratched into the stair rail are four words: WE HEARD IT ANSWER.

name: Beneath the Bell
description:
The stair ends beside a dry basin. In its dust lies the print of a small bare foot, pointing toward the wall. You set down the elder's candle. For the first time all evening, the silence feels like silence.

Your journey through the demo is complete.
